summary: A multi dentist Abu Dhabi centre appears to lose bookings to formatting errors, mixed domains and unnamed proof.

findings.problem: Opening hours appear with stray formatting marks such as four asterisks, and headings appear with stray underscores.
findings.cost: Visible formatting errors make the practice look unfinished and make hours hard to read.

findings.problem: Service cards appear to point to a different domain than the header and booking links, and some images appear to load over an insecure http address.
findings.cost: Mixed domains can break links and trigger browser warnings.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say All right reserved, and article previews appear to end in double dots.
findings.cost: Typos on a medical site reduce trust.

findings.problem: Testimonials appear to be five images with names only, insurance accepted appears with no list of insurers, and the map appears to be a static image.
findings.cost: Thin proof and a static map make it harder for patients to choose and find you.
findings.fix: Dated reviews, a list of insurers and an interactive map.
